name: ceder-6854
steps: Centers Separate Around 1 (Zero Box) This one makes a nice place for a Left Allemande following the Separate Around 1. The dancers are surprised to be facing their corner. A use of 'Separate Around 1' where you neither make a Line nor come into the middle.
note: Untranslatable: "*** not validated *** (Zero Box) Pass Thru"; Untranslatable: "Centers Separate Around 1 (Zero Box) This one makes a nice place for a Left Allemande following the Separate Around 1.
